artifacts.summary: Six-phase documentation-only plan realigning specs/ROADMAP.md with verified repository state: a measurement-first phase producing a command-cited measurement record, four editing phases (Section A census and rows, Completed-section falsified claims, Section B rewrite plus BXCanonical decision-task creation, Section C correction plus four new stream sections), and a whole-document consistency and residue sweep. Every figure is re-measured at execution time rather than copied from the research report.

memory_candidates.content: When a documentation-realignment task must correct figures that a prior review already got wrong, split the plan so that phase 1 is measurement-only and writes a command-cited measurement record artifact, and the final phase audits every figure in the deliverable back against that record. This makes 'the implementer copied a stale number from the plan' a mechanically detectable failure rather than a trust assumption, and preserves the expensive measurement work across a rollback of the edit phases.
